choices.content: The original equation has no solution.

solutions.explanation: Multiplying both sides by \((x-1)(x+1)\) gives \(x+1=2\), so \(x=1\). However, \(x=1\) makes the denominator \(0\), so it is an extraneous solution. Therefore, the original equation has no solution.
solutions.title: Clear denominators and reject the extraneous solution
Show that the two sides never agree
Reduce the difference to a nonzero fraction
